format: voiceover product demo with a mother and baby in a styled living room

hook_0_3s.opening_image: A mother crouching beside foam steps while a baby of about 8 to 12 months crawls up to them in a bright room with long curtains
hook_0_3s.spoken: 0.0-3.6 s machine transcript: 'אם גם הילד שלכן הגיע לשלב שהוא פשוט מטפס על כל דבר בבית,' (voiceover; the mother is interacting with the baby, not facing the lens)
hook_0_3s.reason_to_keep_watching: Interpretation: opens on a relatable problem (a child who climbs everything), shown visually at the same time by a baby climbing the steps.

shots.subject: Mother and baby at the foam steps
shots.purpose: Show the 'climbing' problem and the product at once

shots.subject: Baby on top of the steps, mother helps him slide down the ramp
shots.purpose: Show steps and slide in use

how_value_is_shown: Voiceover names the problem (a child who climbs on everything) and benefits (useful, rearrangeable, stable, non-slip, easy to clean, looks good at home) while the baby and mother use and rearrange the pieces and wipe one clean.
demonstration: Baby climbs steps and slides down the ramp, sits in the cube's hole, crawls around; mother rearranges pieces and wipes a pouf.
proof: A baby using it in a real living room, and a wipe-clean shot. No comparison or before/after.
emotion: Warm, playful: a mother laughing and clapping at her baby.
personal_story: Machine transcript: 'the most useful thing I put in the living room'; no story beyond the baby's climbing stage.
selling_language: 'מצאתי לכם את הפתרון המושלם'; 'הדבר הכי שימושי שהכנסתי לסלון'; caption: '12% הנחה על כל האתר כולל כפל מבצעים'
captions_on_screen: none: no burned-in subtitles or text overlay visible in the frames
editing_rhythm: About 10 shots (cuts at 5.3, 6.3, 7.3, 7.8, 8.2, 9.1, 11.2, 11.6, 12.2 s), average about 1.7 s; the opening 5 s is one continuous fixed shot, cuts accelerate after 5 s.
ending_and_cta: Last 3 s show the mother laughing and clapping next to the baby in the cube. Caption CTA: comment 'לינק' and she sends the link; 12% discount on the whole site.
price_or_code: caption: '12% הנחה על כל האתר כולל כפל מבצעים' (a discount, no code word written; link sent in DM)
convincing: Interpretation: opens with a real parent problem, the mother's natural interaction with the baby, and a clean, bright home; the comment-for-link CTA fits the numbers (64 comments vs 3 likes shown, with like counts hidden: counts unreliable).
weak_or_overproduced: Interpretation: voiceover is script-like and reads as ad copy, no on-screen text or subtitles; the styled room and perfect framing make it feel like a brand shoot.
lumebook_lesson: Interpretation: open with the problem in one sentence over the real action, keep a fixed wide phone shot for the first 5 s, and use a comment-a-word CTA with a discount for followers. For LumeBook: parent turns pages with a toddler, voiceover names the problem, comment 'לינק'.
solo_without_child: no: the value is shown by a baby using the product with the mother.
not_verified: Whether the voice is the creator's; some words are misheard in the machine transcript ('הוא השכרה נראה טוב'); like count is hidden by the account so 3 likes is not a real figure; follower count; whether any text overlay exists that the contact sheet missed. Fixed 18 Oct from the 8-question pass: no code word; the 12% discount comes through the DM link (old values in src/coded_fixes_2026-10-18.json).
